description_en: Modifies the name of a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP)
description_zh: 调用ModifyHaVipAttribute接口修改HaVip实例的名称
name: ModifyHaVipAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the HAVIP that you want to modify
parameters.name: ha_vip_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the HAVIP. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh: HaVip实例的名称。名称长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: name
